plugins.name: fugaro
plugins.description: Five skills for Fugaro: set a repository up, work with runs, route work between cloud and local, plan parallel work, and upgrade a checkout to the installed fugaro. Fugaro runs coding-agent tasks in fleeting cloud containers and always ends with a pull request.
